text:
maria: Quick ask 11 run a focused pricing UX micro-experiment this week aimed at infra/platform buyers. Keep changes minimal and measurable.

lee: Sounds good. Whats in scope?

maria: Draft plan:
1) Tier names: change to `Dev / Production / Reserved` (try clearer signal for isolation/commitment).
2) Add 1-line bullets under each tier: SLA (uptime), data isolation, typical tokens/sec.
3) Swap current calculator for a stripped-down estimator (inputs: monthly requests, avg tokens/request, cache %).

own: We should A/B test two treatments: A = name+bullets, B = copy tweaks only (no renaming). Measure MQL rate + calculator usage.

sam: Agree on AB. Also add an FAQ entry: "Which option should I pick for regulated workloads?" -> reply: "Reserved or Private deployments; contact sales for on-prem." short and link to compliance page.

alexa: For the calculator, suggested minimal payload for engineers to implement: 
```
{
  "requests_per_month": 120000,
  "avg_tokens": 500,
  "cache_percent": 0.4,
  "private_toggle": false
}
```
Outputs: est monthly tokens, est hosted cost, recommended tier (rule: if tokens>40M and cache<50% -> recommend Production or Reserved). If `private_toggle` true, show "Contact sales for private pricing" and attach lead form.

lee: I'll set up the A/B in Optimizely. Events: `calc_open`, `estimate_private_click`, `mql_submit`, `faq_view`. Can we tag form submissions with `pricing-experiment-ux`?

maria: Yes, route those to inbound-sales with the tag. Also high-value flag if est monthly spend > $40k -> ping sales slack channel.

own: I'll deliver a tiny React widget PR tonight. Implementation notes in the PR: localize numbers, round to nearest 10, show small accuracy blurb: "Estimated cost within +-10%".

sam: Marketing copy for bullets + FAQ I'll draft and drop here. Need legal to glance at the calculator language before staging.

alexa: marketing-bot: please remind legal & privacy to review the staged changes by Thursday 09:00 PT.

marketing-bot: Reminder queued: please have staged changes ready by Thu 09:00 PT for legal & privacy review.

maria: Final checklist: PR for widget -> eng review, Optimizely setup -> lee, FAQ + bullets -> sam, form routing -> alexa. Stage Thu AM, launch Fri morning PT. Quick results sync next Tue.

alexa: Thanks team 680 will follow up with timeline in calendar invite.
